# cxxopts / cxxopts_fuzz_test

cxxopts's own fuzz target `cxxopts_fuzz_test` ([source](source/fuzz.cpp), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over cxxopts (jarro2783/cxxopts at b6135315).

Builds a cxxopts::Options with up to 1024 fuzzed options of types int/string/vector<string>/float/double, optional positional and allow_unrecognised, then options.parse(argc, argv) of up to 1024 fuzzed args; the ParseResult is never read and catch (...) swallows every exception.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against cxxopts at commit b6135315.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- assert(options); assert(provider); in add_fuzzed_option -- non-null checks on pointers the harness itself passes from locals; trivially true ([lines 24-25](source/fuzz.cpp#L24-L25)): assert(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch cxxopts` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `cxxopts_fuzz_test.plain` | 826,840 | `67d5bfc1d719752eba770e7ecb6097d8486d582fc6f7c55e37b76adbff5b2287` |
| ubsan | `cxxopts_fuzz_test.ubsan` | 866,328 | `100a45ba0247e37be7534f7f114cd9265b634843a5561b8352695e5c0b376677` |
| asan | `cxxopts_fuzz_test.asan` | 1,555,560 | `5a4d990ac20ca2441127b3f704473a3a2452ec9db511cf74bb509977d549487c` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
